summary: The Entropy Maw is the devouring sink at the heart of the Entropic Deep. It consumes collapsing timelines, nullified realities, and fragments of cosmic decay.
history: Formed during the first collapse of the Void.
Entropy condensed into a metaphysical pressure well.
Creatures of collapse emerged from the Maw’s anti‑radiance.
The Maw of Collapse became the region’s apex predator.
